questions.question: How long has this been on your mind?
questions.subtext: Honest answers help us match the right psychologist.

options.label: Just the last few weeks
A few months
More than six months
It's a pattern across relationships

questions.question: What's going on right now?
questions.subtext: Pick the one that fits most.

options.label: I'm in a relationship and it's hard
I'm processing a breakup or separation
Things with family are weighing on me
I keep ending up in the same kind of relationship

questions.question: Which of these feel most familiar?

options.label: We have the same fight on repeat
I feel unseen or unheard
I shut down or pull away when it gets hard
I overthink every message and silence
I'm holding on tighter than I'd like to admit

questions.question: When you imagine yourself in this — what do you notice?

options.label: I become someone I don't recognise
I'm walking on eggshells
I keep making myself smaller
I want to fix it but I don't know how

questions.question: Have you tried anything for this?
questions.subtext: Whatever the answer is, it's okay.

options.label: No, this is my first step
Books, podcasts, talking to friends
Couples or individual therapy in the past
I'm in therapy now and want more focus on this

questions.question: How ready do you feel to work on this?
questions.subtext: It's okay if you're still figuring it out.

questions.question: What would feel different if things were better?
questions.subtext: There's no right answer — pick what resonates.

options.label: I'd feel safe to say what I actually think
I'd stop bracing for the next argument
I'd recognise myself again in the relationship
I'd choose different patterns going forward
